properties.snippet: Location information for Wisconsin’s Wild and Scenic Rivers. Wild and Scenic Rivers are relatively unmodified streams and rivers in Wisconsin.
properties.description: Wild and Scenic Rivers are established to protect natural streams, to attract out–of–state visitors, to assure the well–being of our tourist industry, and to preserve some rivers in a free-flowing condition and protect them from development. This dataset is useful for locating recreation opportunities on free-flowing Wisconsin Rivers. More information on Wisconsin’s Wild and Scenic Rivers can be found at the DNR’s page on Wisconsin’s wild and scenic rivers.

properties.snippet: Hosted Vector Tile layer consisting of Wisconsin DNR and other government lands, Tribal lands, County and National Forests, hydrography, transportation, and municipality boundaries for the state of Wisconsin.
properties.description:
This is a Vector Tile layer consisting of Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources managed lands including state parks, recreation areas, wildlife areas, fishery areas, and state natural areas. Other government lands include US Fish and Wildlife Service, National Park Service, Bureau of Land Management, and County and National Forests. This map also contains Tribal lands, hydrography, Open Street Map transportation, and municipality boundaries.

Map and Data are projected to WTM projection WKID 3071 with an 18 scale tiling scheme ranging from 1:4,620,288 to 1:282.

To use add to Web Map as a basemap.

Data Last Updated: 6/18/2026

properties.snippet: This data layer includes lines representing existing sections of the Ice Age National Scenic Trail.   This version of the data is hosted by Wisconsin DNR for DNR staff use and public download and is updated approximately every two months.
properties.description:
This layer is hosted by Wisconsin DNR, and reflects Ice Age Trail updates received from the Ice Age Trail Alliance on July 31, 2026.  This layer is typically updated approximately every two months and is primarily for the purpose of DNR staff use and public download from DNR"s Open Data Portal. 

 

For the most current Ice Age Trail layer, see the Ice Age Trail Alliance's official layer.   Contact Tiffany Stram (tiffany@iceagetrail.org) GIS/Technology Specialist at Ice Age Trail Alliance with any questions about the official layer. For the official depiction of Ice Age Trails in Wisconsin, see see Ice Age National Scenic Trail Existing Sections - Official Layer.  

 

This layer's data includes lines representing existing sections of the Ice Age National Scenic Trail. This layer is a combination of GPS and digitized data, merged to represent one complete data layer for the IAT. The data was developed by the Ice Age Trail Alliance (IATA) in cooperation with the National Park Service's Ice Age Trail Office.

properties.snippet: Wisconsin DNR wolf hunting management zones
properties.description:
This is a polygon feature class representing Wisconsin DNR Wolf Management Zones. Wolf Management Zones indicate the areas with various wolf hunting regulations throughout Wisconsin. Hunting regulations may vary between and within zones. Users should consult the most recent Hunting Regulations Handbook to determine which regulations apply to which zones, or portions of zones.

Wolf Management Zones allow the DNR to better control the distribution of hunters and shift hunting pressure to areas of high nuisance and/or damage complaints.

candidates.title: Deer Management Zones, Units, and Metro Subunits

properties.snippet: Wisconsin DNR deer and deer hunting management zones, including units and metro subunits.
properties.description:
Wisconsin DNR Deer Management Units and Metro sub-units separated by Zones.

 
Field definitions:
  • DEER_MGMT_UNIT_ID (shapefile: DEER_MGMT_) - Deer Management Unit (DMU):  DMUs mirror county boundaries in the Central and Southern Farmland zones and are habitat-based in the Northern and Central Forest zones. Metropolitan subunits, islands of the Apostle Islands National Lakeshore and Madeline Island in Ashland County or being within the exterior boundaries of the Bad River, Lac Courte Oreilles, Lac du Flambeau, Menominee and Red Cliff Reservations have separate boundaries. Antlerless deer quotas and authorizations are decided at the DMU level.
     
  • DEER_MANAGEMENT_ZONE (shapefile: DEER_MANAG) - Deer Management Zone (DMZ):  DMUs grouped together in similar habitat types
     
  • METRO_SUBUNIT (shapefile: METRO_SUBU) - Metropolitan deer management subunits that are a subdivided part of a DMU due to it being in an urban area.
     
  • DEER_MGMT_UNIT_NAME (shapefile: DEER_MGMT1) - a combination of the deer management unit (DMU), the Metro Subunit, and the zone (DMZ).

properties.snippet: Polygon layer containing all blocks developed as part of the second Wisconsin Breeding Bird Atlas (WBBA II) in 2015.
properties.description:
Polygon layer containing all blocks developed as part of the second Wisconsin Breeding Bird Atlas (WBBA II) in 2015.

Sources used to generate the 2015 WBBA blocks and supporting datasets:

  • 1:24,000 Quad Index:  USGS
  • County Lines: 2013 US Census TIGER
  • WI State Boundary:  WDNR
  • National Hydrography waterbody dataset
Also see the Wisconsin Breeding Bird Atlas II interactive map on Wisconsin DNR's website.
